column1: # Hand-curated usage tags for English. For a word listed here, these tags REPLACE the
# dictionary's own tags; "none" clears them (to fix upstream false positives).
# ESDB only tags "the worst offenders", so this adds slurs and vulgar words it misses.
# Same scheme as ESDB (see its README, USAGE-NOTE):
#   offensive-2  offensive slurs with somewhat less stigma
#   vulgar-3     mildly vulgar or taboo words
# Deliberately NOT tagged, because a common harmless meaning dominates: chink, cock,
# prick, pussy, tit, nip, cracker, mick, paddy, lame, hoe, bloody, sod, knob, cripple,
# gypsy, midget, negro, redneck, gringo, nonce, bimbo, retarded.
# Upstream false positives: ESDB tags these vulgar-3, but the harmless sense dominates.
